narrative.overview: The built interface combines a dark broadcast frame with warm score sheets. Condensed numerals make position and score the first things to scan; ordinary body text carries names, rule clauses and evidence. The user pinned the music-chart and sports-broadcast world with trading-card rosters and weekly scoreboards. This operates a league: standings, roster selection and weekly evidence precede promotional copy. Pending data remains unscored; recorded and live proof have separate labels.
keyCharacteristics: Condensed chart numerals beside readable explanations.
Paper score rows inside a charcoal broadcast frame.
Acid selection accents and small vermilion signals.
Trading-card rosters with six-week point strips.
Evidence and transaction links adjacent to outcomes.

rules.name: The State Truth Rule
rules.body: Color reinforces a written state; green alone never proves finality, evidence sufficiency or payment.

rules.name: The Number First Rule
rules.body: Positions and points use the condensed face; evidence, rules and field values use body text.

dos: Do preserve paper score sheets, the dark frame and condensed numerals.
Do keep native labelled controls and disabled-state explanations.
Do distinguish recorded proof, live reads and pending transactions.
Do keep evidence links and literal quotations near results.
donts: Don't replace actual outcomes with mocked completed scores.
Don't republish full charts in the app; show roster positions and link to Billboard.
Don't inherit tiny decorative captions as action or form text.
